title: Export Sector Status
description: Adds a liveness check method to the builtin miner actor to allow for user space fevm contracts to check on the status of filecoin sectors based on sector number.

storageProviders: Enables integration with FEVM contracts for real-time sector status monitoring
Supports better coordination with smart contract-based storage solutions
clients: Allows decentralized applications to verify sector status without trust in centralized services
tokenHolders: No direct impact on FIL token economics
applicationDevelopers: Developers can build FEVM contracts that react to sector state changes
Enables new patterns for decentralized storage coordination
